title: With Cache Components, a SYNCHRONOUS fs read freezes into the static shell
statement: With cacheComponents enabled, a Server Component that reads an artifact with fs.readFileSync produces output baked into the static shell, so a later external write to that file does not change what a fresh request returns.
notes: ⚠️ CONTESTED, AND THE CONTEST IS THE DIAGNOSIS. The documentation (EVD-0006) supports it; the dev experiment (EVD-0012) refutes it. Both are applicable because the claim NAMES NO MODE — and that is the defect. The doc describes prerendering 'at build time'; the experiment ran `next dev`, where there is no build. Scoping resolves it into two claims that do not conflict: AST-0010 (build mode, source-supported, untested) and AST-0011 (dev mode, experimentally confirmed). Kept contested on purpose rather than tidied away: it is a live example of #96's contested verdict doing what it was built for — surfacing a condition without guessing its cause — where the cause turned out to be a modelling error in the claim rather than disagreement about the world.
